subject.title: [Refactor] Abstract OAuth flow parameters out of LLM transport core

question: Should any provider-specific OAuth flow configuration become part of the `AiTransportHost` contract, or must it remain entirely within provider-plugin authentication contracts?
rationale: Both boundaries are technically possible, but the repository currently treats provider credentials and authentication as plugin/application concerns; accepting a new transport-host contract therefore requires explicit owner intent and a concrete use case.

options.title: Keep OAuth provider-owned
options.body: Require the reporter to identify an exact hardcoded parameter and blocked provider, then extend the existing provider-auth contract only if that example proves a missing seam.

options.title: Sponsor a generic host contract
options.body: Approve a provider-neutral transport-host port after specifying its invariant, lifecycle, compatibility expectations, and why provider runtime-auth preparation is insufficient.

recommendation.title: Keep OAuth provider-owned
recommendation.body: Require the reporter to identify an exact hardcoded parameter and blocked provider, then extend the existing provider-auth contract only if that example proves a missing seam.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged OpenAI OAuth implementation is the strongest direct history signal for deciding whether the remaining behavior belongs to provider auth or transport infrastructure.
